title: The Ski Bus at its depot
notes: Ski Bus Depot (2666.6, 797.9, -1713.0), seen from the north across the street and the parking slope, 40 m out, a long lens: the SKI BUS pylon and the depot shelter large and sunlit at sim 15:00 (Time of Day 15). The coach (SkiCoachBus, one in the city) has the SKI BUS lettering on both sides. It drives in from the A-Frame stop (2755, -1625), down the street (2702, -1666), (2686, -1679), (2670, -1692), stops at the depot near (2661, -1700), then turns away from the camera. About 3 s real from x 2745 to the stop at sim speed 1, then a dwell at the depot; it waits about 10 s at the A-Frame stop. Trigger: poll the coach's InterpolatedTransform every 250 ms at sim speed 1 (normal frame rate) and start the sequence when it drives inbound (x falling) between x 2745 and 2700; the sequence switches capture mode on, hides the UI and runs the 9 s path. The recorded frame is wider than a `photo` still from the same Photo Mode camera (block B noted the same). A parked van stands in front of the shelter and pedestrians cross the near sidewalk. Take 2: 60 mm. Take 3: 85 mm (the alt85 values). Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).
